channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Survey: Many Workers Skip Doctor Visits Due to Financial Concerns
item.description: About a third of employees said they delayed or skipped medical or dental care in the past year because of money worries, a new survey found.

item.title: Federal agencies probe suspicious letters sent to congressional offices
item.description: Multiple federal agencies are investigating letters containing suspicious substances mailed nationwide, according to a notice.

item.title: Growing number of young adults live with parents
item.description: ABC News' Juju Chang reports on the rise of boomerang kids returning to live with their parents amid housing costs and financial concerns.

item.title: Eric Deters sues Kimberly Guilfoyle for defamation
item.description: Eric Deters, a GOP donor who said Kimberly Guilfoyle asked him to wire her $100,000, has sued her and her lawyers.
